leadText: Aliana (Japanese: アケビ Akebi) is one of five Team Flare scientists in Pokémon X and Y.
plainText:
Aliana (Japanese: アケビ Akebi) is one of five Team Flare scientists in Pokémon X and Y.

==In the core series games==
Aliana is one of five Team Flare scientists that are the driving force behind the team, being distinguishable with her orange hair. She is first seen at the Kalos Power Plant with one of the s. Although she's defeated, she declares their operation of stealing energy from the plant a success and leaves.

She is later met again at Lysandre Labs, preparing for Team Flare's plan to use the ultimate weapon.

===Quotes===
 
==== ====
Kalos Power Plant
First meeting
"If you're just interested in the facts, I'd say we already have enough energy to power the device."
"What other work do you mean? Perhaps you mean taking out that annoying little Pokémon Trainer over there?"
"Ah ha ha! It would be my pleasure. Come on, little Trainer! Let's see what you've got!"

Before battle
"Allow me to introduce myself, intruder. My name is Aliana. As you can see, I'm one of Team Flare's Scientists. I'm researching a certain something that you wouldn't understand, anyway. Unfortunately for you, I've been charged with the simple task of your elimination."

Being defeated
"You're quite strong. Oh yes--very strong, indeed."

After being defeated
"Ah ha ha! Well, I certainly didn't expect you to be so interesting! I do hope we can meet again!"

Lysandre Labs
Before battle
"Ah ha ha! Why, if it isn't that fascinating little Trainer from the Kalos Power Plant. So we meet again, just as I said we would!"

Being defeated
"You sure are an interesting Trainer. You're far more capable than our useless Grunts."

After being defeated
"I don't have the key, but I'll let you pass. But which warp panel could it be? Which one cooould it be?"

If talked to again
"I had fun at the Kalos Power Plant. Of course, we could have generated electricity with Team Flare's technology, too, you know. We just didn't think it justified the cost. To create a world for us and us alone, we have to play it smart, you see."

===Pokémon the Series===
====History====
In the past, Aliana, alongside Lysandre and the other Team Flare Scientists, would help those in need, until Lysandre became disillusioned with the human race and sought to restart the world.

Aliana debuted in From A to Z!. She was seen at Lysandre Labs with Bryony when Xerosic informed that she would be tasked with capturing , which Mable had recently failed to accomplish.
 
Aliana briefly appeared in Meeting at Terminus Cave! in a video call with Xerosic, where she and Mable got ordered to head to Z2 after Team Flare found out its location thanks to their sensors.

In An Explosive Operation!, she, Mable, and several s were trying to capture Z2. When she and Mable ordered their Pokémon, and , to attack Z2, it transformed into its and used its powerful attacks to blow Team Flare away and managed to escape. She and Mable quickly managed to catch up to it, only to face , who wanted Z2 for themselves. Thanks to Team Rocket, Z2 managed to escape once again. Team Flare, however, quickly found them and a battle between both took place. After a prolonged struggle, Team Flare emerged victorious and managed to corner Z2. This, however, triggered Z2 to transform to its 50% Forme and easily blew Aliana and the others back. As Z2 was about to finish them off, Alain and his interfered and battled Z2 to buy her and Mable time. While Z2 was battling, she and Mable surprised it by shooting it with their laser guns, finally bringing it down and captured it, completing their mission.

In A Towering Takeover!, during Team Flare's attack on Lumiose City, Aliana was guarding the Prism Tower with Bryony and used her Druddigon to prevent , , , Clembot, and Blaziken Mask from entering. In the following episode, she and Bryony battled Clemont, Clembot, and Blaziken Mask, but both ended up getting defeated and were captured, allowing Clemont and Clembot to enter Prism Tower.

===Pokémon Adventures===
 
Aliana debuted in X-actly What They Wanted. She, Mable, and a group of s traveled to Vaniville Town to steal 's Mega Ring. While protecting her from the two scientists, X's Kanga was injured. This angered Kanga's baby, Li'l Kanga, who reacted to the Mega Ring and Mega Evolved into Mega Kangaskhan and easily drove the villains off.

In Inn-teresting Developments, X's friends stayed at an Aquacorde Town inn while he slept in the tent on 's 's back. The inn was a trap designed to keep Y and the others inside while Aliana and Mable tried to steal Li'l Kanga when X wasn't looking. Y broke out and informed X of the situation, but when he tried to Mega Evolve Li'l Kanga again, it failed. With no other options, X and Y teamed up with Chespin and Froakie to defeat the scientists. X had Chespin pin Aliana and Mable to a tree with , preventing them from chasing the Vaniville children as they fled to a nearby forest. 

In The Aegislash Agenda, Aliana and Mable met with Bryony and Xerosic at the Team Flare Secret HQ. They were informed that their repeat failures have led to Celosia taking over their duties.

In Gyarados Changes, Aliana and the other female scientists witnessed X trying to break into the Secret HQ. Noting Celosia hadn't slept since she brought Xerneas back to base, Aliana and Mable offered to stop X in her place, only for Bryony to tell them to return to their stations. Later, after the ultimate weapon was stopped by X and his friends, Aliana and Mable helped Bryony up after she was defeated by Y and her newly caught Xerxer.

In Charizard Transforms, Aliana and the other female scientists each intercepted Y and her friends to prevent them from reaching the Pokémon Village. Aliana picked Y as her opponent, but their battle was interrupted when Y left to go help her friends fight . When Y came back to assist and with , they were ambushed by Aliana and Bryony. Trevor decided to stay behind to fight by himself and told Y to go to the village and help X. Later, after Trevor managed to take down Bryony, Aliana attempted a sneak attack, only to be ambushed by Tierno and Shauna, forcing her to give up.
